01 / About me

A good beginning.
An open road.

I’m Divya Kumar, a first-year student at NST-RU, exploring the foundations of programming, machine learning, and app development. I like understanding how things work — and discovering what I can make with that knowledge.

I’m at the beginning of the journey, with basic Python and Java, a curious mind, and plenty of room to grow. Away from the screen, you’ll find me behind the wheel or putting in time at the gym.

Here’s to what’s next.
